text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though feeling her way through, Transcend 
was able to run the Mile Championship 
Nambu Hai with a clear, unwavering mind 
for the first time in a long while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And buoyed by Espoir City's kind yet 
rough-and-tumble encouragement, Transcend 
looks forward, determined to collect data 
once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though differing in gravity, it felt 
similar to rebuilding a disaster-stricken 
area. If she can overcome her current 
state and reach the top of the dirt racing 
world, it will surely bring encouragement 
to the disaster victims.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to gather data on the Big Three 
once more, Transcend set her sights on the 
JBC Classic as her next goal!
